about.founderBio: Started PET+ after adopting three cats and realizing the neighborhood lacked real pet care.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before buying or booking

items.a: Delivery time varies by ZIP code, but on average we deliver within 5 business days in major cities. You can track the status in "My Account".

items.q: How does the exchange/return process work?
items.a: You have up to 7 calendar days after receiving your order to request an exchange or return, as long as the product is unused and in its original packaging. See full details in our Exchange Policy.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept Pix (instant approval), credit card in up to 3 interest-free installments, and bank slip.

items.q: How do I book a bath, grooming or vet appointment?
items.a: Just click "Book on WhatsApp" on any service page, or use the floating WhatsApp button. Our team confirms the time quickly.

items.q: Do you deliver large bags of pet food?
items.a: Yes! We carry bags up to 15kg, with shipping automatically calculated by your ZIP code in the cart.

items.q: Can I pick up my order in store?
items.a: Sure can. In the delivery step of checkout, just choose "Pick up in store" — no shipping cost.

exchange.title: Exchange & Return Policy
exchange.content:
You have up to 7 calendar days after receiving the product to request an exchange or return, in accordance with consumer protection law.

The product must show no signs of use, with original packaging and invoice. Personal pet hygiene items (such as brushes and opened products) are not eligible for exchange for sanitary reasons, except in case of a manufacturing defect.

To request one, contact us via WhatsApp or the Contact page with your order number. Refunds are processed within 10 business days after the returned product is received and confirmed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
PET+ respects your privacy and your pet's. We only collect the data needed to process orders, book services and improve your experience: name, email, phone, tax ID and address.

Your data is never sold to third parties. We use payment and delivery providers solely to fulfill your purchase. You may request deletion of your data at any time via Contact.

We use cookies to keep your cart saved and improve site navigation.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content:
By using the PET+ website, you agree to these terms. Prices and product availability may change without notice. Bath, grooming, veterinary and hotel services are subject to time confirmation via WhatsApp.

The content of this site (text, images, visual identity) belongs to PET+ and may not be reproduced without authorization. We reserve the right to refuse orders in cases of suspected fraud.
